title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named public-facing destinations along Downtown Pomona corridors, each paired with one directly sourced reason to make the trip from Cal Poly Pomona.

cards.title: See Ceramics Across Eras
cards.subtitle: North Garey Avenue — ceramic-art exhibitions
cards.notes: Take North Garey Avenue to AMOCA and check the current exhibition list before planning a Friday-through-Sunday museum visit.
cards.short_summary: A museum stop centered specifically on ceramic art, history, creation, and technology.
cards.evidence_claim: AMOCA identifies its Pomona location at 399 North Garey Avenue and presents ceramic art through exhibitions, collections, outreach, and studio programming.
cards.source_title: The American Museum of Ceramic Art / AMOCA — Pomona, California
cards.access_notes: The museum currently lists public hours Friday through Sunday, 11 a.m.–4 p.m.; admission is charged, with some reduced or free categories.

cards.title: Use the City Library
cards.subtitle: South Garey Avenue — collections and public programs
cards.notes: Follow South Garey Avenue to the library, then consult its city calendar for current reading, chess, craft, or technology programs.
cards.short_summary: A civic destination for browsing collections and checking the current public-program calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Pomona lists Pomona Public Library at 625 South Garey Avenue and provides catalog access, operating hours, and an events calendar.
cards.source_title: Pomona Public Library | City of Pomona, CA
cards.access_notes: Current city hours are noon–7 p.m. Monday–Thursday and 11 a.m.–5 p.m. Saturday; closed Friday and Sunday.

cards.title: Drop Into a Community Exhibition
cards.subtitle: South Main Street — exhibitions, classes, and music
cards.notes: Walk South Main Street to the dA, browse during exhibition hours, and check its class catalog separately when a workshop interests you.
cards.short_summary: A community arts center where exhibitions provide the clearest walk-in reason to visit.
cards.evidence_claim: The dA Center states that its South Main Street venue hosts exhibitions and that events are free with no reservation unless otherwise stated.
cards.source_title: Visit | dA Center for the Arts
cards.access_notes: Exhibition hours are listed Tuesday–Saturday 1–5 p.m., Sunday 1–4 p.m., and Second Saturday 1–9 p.m.; classes may require registration.

cards.title: Look for Local Sculpture
cards.subtitle: West Second Street — sculpture and local art
cards.notes: Head along West Second Street to the sculpture park and use the Arts Colony listing to anchor a public-art-focused downtown walk.
cards.short_summary: A named West Second Street destination devoted to sculpture and work by local artists.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona Arts Colony lists 2nd St. Sculpture Park at 538 West Second Street as a sculpture park and art gallery featuring local artists and live music.
cards.source_title: Museums and Galleries | Pomona Arts Colony
cards.access_notes: The source identifies the destination and address but does not publish current visiting hours; verify access before departure.

cards.title: Browse Chicano Children’s Literature
cards.subtitle: South Thomas Street — bookstore and gallery
cards.notes: Turn onto South Thomas Street for a bookstore-gallery stop, and confirm current opening hours directly before making a dedicated trip.
cards.short_summary: A combined bookstore and art gallery with a documented focus on Chicano literature for children.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona Arts Colony lists Cafe Con Libros at 280 South Thomas Street as a bookstore and art gallery offering Chicano literature for kids and reading assistance.
cards.source_title: Museums and Galleries | Pomona Arts Colony
cards.access_notes: The Arts Colony source supplies the address and purpose but no current hours; confirm public access with the destination.

cards.title: See Student and Faculty Art
cards.subtitle: West Second Street — School of Arts & Enterprise gallery
cards.notes: Add the West Second Street gallery to an art walk, prioritizing dates when student, faculty, or guest work is publicly on view.
cards.short_summary: A school-affiliated gallery with a documented mix of student, faculty, and guest artists.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona Arts Colony lists Downtown Center Gallery at 300 West Second Street as a School of Arts & Enterprise gallery featuring student, faculty, and guest artists.
cards.source_title: Museums and Galleries | Pomona Arts Colony
cards.access_notes: The directory establishes the gallery and street address but not current exhibition hours; check before visiting.

cards.title: Focus on Student Artists
cards.subtitle: South Main Street — student gallery
cards.notes: Continue down South Main Street to the Berger Gallery and verify that a student exhibition is open before scheduling the stop.
cards.short_summary: A South Main Street gallery specifically identified with exhibitions by student artists.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona Arts Colony identifies The Lucille H. Berger Gallery at 375 South Main Street as a School of Arts & Enterprise gallery featuring student artists.
cards.source_title: Museums and Galleries | Pomona Arts Colony
cards.access_notes: No current hours appear in the cited listing; confirm exhibition dates and public entry before traveling.

cards.title: Find Collegiate Art
cards.subtitle: South Thomas Street — collaborative gallery
cards.notes: Use South Thomas Street for this collaborative gallery stop, checking its current program before expecting collegiate work on display.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative exhibition venue documented as showing both local and collegiate artists.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona Arts Colony lists The Progress Gallery at 300-B South Thomas Street as a collaborative neighborhood venue featuring local and collegiate artists.
cards.source_title: Museums and Galleries | Pomona Arts Colony
cards.access_notes: The cited directory does not provide current gallery hours or exhibition dates; verify both before the trip.

cards.title: Pair Art With the Downtown Office
cards.subtitle: West Second Street — lobby gallery
cards.notes: Stop on West Second Street to see the lobby gallery, timing the visit only after confirming office access and a current display.
cards.short_summary: A compact gallery located inside the Downtown Pomona Owners Association lobby.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona Arts Colony lists Metro Art Gallery at 119 West Second Street and identifies it as the gallery in the Downtown Pomona Owners Association lobby.
cards.source_title: Museums and Galleries | Pomona Arts Colony
cards.access_notes: Because the gallery is in an office lobby, consult the destination for current exhibition access before visiting.

cards.title: Explore Art From Across the Americas
cards.subtitle: South Thomas Street — Latino and Latina artists
cards.notes: Make South Thomas Street the route to this museum, then confirm its current exhibition and opening schedule before departure.
cards.short_summary: A museum whose documented focus connects Latino and Latina artists throughout the Americas.
cards.evidence_claim: Pomona Arts Colony lists Latino Art Museum at 281 South Thomas Street, Suite 105, as showcasing work by Latino and Latina artists living throughout the Americas.
cards.source_title: Museums and Galleries | Pomona Arts Colony
cards.access_notes: The cited Arts Colony page provides the museum address and focus but not current hours; verify access in advance.
